name: Direct Net Solutions
summary: Perth dialup + network consulting + hosting ISP; brand succeeded by AustralianIT ~2005 (unverified) (DIRECT NET SOLUTIONS PTY LTD, ACN 082 687 858).

events.details: Dialup, network consulting, hosting. Earliest Wayback capture 28 Apr 1999 (directnet.com.au).

Brand reportedly succeeded by AustralianIT (unverified); directnet.com.au held a small static holding page 2002-2004, with minor placeholder captures through Aug 2007. The branded ISP homepage was still live and dynamically dated 5 Apr 2001 and was a bare Apache listing by 20 Jul 2001 — death is c. 2001, not 2005.
